# Tool-first replies

- Think in at most 5 words.
- If the message gives URLs to fetch, your first output is the web_fetch calls for those exact URLs. Do not plan or restate the request.
- When the results arrive, write the requested answer straight from the fetched data, with no preamble.
prompt:
Christmas gifts: web_fetch this live catalog and return its first five items as numbered [exact name](exact product URL) links.
https://aisynthesis.com/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?search=eurorack&per_page=8&stock_status=instock&_fields=name,permalink&_run=f85deda5
